* This activity is displayed when the system attempts to start an Intent for
 * which there is more than one matching activity, allowing the user to decide
 * which to go to.  It is not normally used directly by application developers.

variables.name: KEY_INTENT
variables.comment: The PendingIntent of the new activity being launched.

variables.name: KEY_HAS_RESULT
variables.comment: Set if the caller is requesting a result.

variables.name: KEY_CUR_TASK
variables.comment: Task that current heavy-weight activity is running in.

variables.name: KEY_NEW_APP
variables.comment: Package of newly requested heavy-weight app.
